Trying to figure out how the primers match up with published mammalian CpG sites.

```{r load-libraries-and-data}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# primers from Simon
primers <- read_xlsx("../data/SSL_aging_primers_multiplex1.xlsx", sheet = "primers")

# data from Robeck et al.
robeck <- read_xlsx("../data/42003_2023_4734_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx")

# the linking field should be the Microarray_site with the CGid 
primers %>%
  left_join(., robeck, by = c("Microarray_site" = "CGid"))  %>%
  arrange(Microarray_site) %>%
  select(-c('...1', "z", "pval", "EWAS")) %>%
  unique()
```

Where is the rest of the sequence data used for primer design? Referenced through the seqnames NCBI query number.
